meta.name: deep-research
meta.description: Use this skill when the user wants an evidence-based research memo, literature review, market/policy/technical landscape, or a multi-source decision brief with citations, trade-offs, and a clear conclusion. Best for tasks that need synthesis across multiple external sources, iterative follow-up research, or a reusable written artifact. Do not use for quick factual lookups, single-source summaries, simple Q&A, summarizing one document the user already provided, plan-only requests where the user explicitly defers the actual research, or when the user wants a short answer with no need for cited evidence (a short but evidence-backed conclusion is still a brief memo, which this skill covers). Chinese trigger examples: "帮我调研", "深度研究", "综述报告", "技术选型分析", "竞品研究", "政策分析".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成带引用的多源研究备忘录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要基于多源证据撰写调研报告或决策简报。
copy.tagline_en: Generate evidence-based research memos with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to synthesize multiple sources into a cited research memo.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按流程产出带引用的研究备忘录、综述或决策简报。它会先制定研究计划，再搜索、提取证据，最后合成报告，并附上局限性和不确定性说明。
howto.when: 当你要求做需要多方证据综合的调研、综述或分析时触发，例如说“帮我调研”、“深度研究”、“技术选型分析”等。

say.text: 帮我调研一下量子计算的当前技术路线。
say.note: Claude 会生成一份带引用的研究备忘录。

say.text: 写一份关于新能源汽车市场的竞品分析报告。
say.note: Claude 会产出包含证据和权衡的完整报告。

say.text: 继续上一轮研究，深化关于AI伦理的部分。
say.note: Claude 会以增量更新模式补充新内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows a workflow to produce evidence-based research memos, literature reviews, or decision briefs with citations. It plans, searches, extracts evidence, synthesizes a report, and includes limitations and uncertainty.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests multi-source synthesis research, such as saying "帮我调研", "深度研究", or "技术选型分析".

say_en.text: Research the current technical routes for quantum computing.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a cited research memo.

say_en.text: Write a competitive analysis report on the new energy vehicle market.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a full report with evidence and trade-offs.

say_en.text: Continue the previous research, deepening the AI ethics section.
say_en.note: Claude will update with a delta mode.
